description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.
